SUPER_ADMIN.responsibilities: Owns user accounts, role assignment, all content and projects, media, editorial approvals and system operations.

COMPANY_ADMIN.name: Company Admin
COMPANY_ADMIN.description: Manages all company content, media and users.
COMPANY_ADMIN.responsibilities: Runs day-to-day company operations: articles, projects, services, company pages, media library and user accounts (except Super Admin assignment).

CONTENT_MANAGER.name: Content Manager
CONTENT_MANAGER.description: Creates and manages articles, services and company content.
CONTENT_MANAGER.responsibilities: Authors and curates articles, services and company content; uploads media; drives the editorial pipeline (reviews and schedules).

PROJECT_MANAGER.name: Project Manager
PROJECT_MANAGER.responsibilities: Owns the project portfolio: project metadata, case studies, cover and gallery media, and the project publishing workflow.

EDITOR.name: Editor
EDITOR.responsibilities: Writes and refines article content, uploads supporting media and participates in editorial reviews.

VIEWER.name: Viewer
VIEWER.responsibilities: Reads published content and follows editorial progress. Cannot create, edit or publish anything.
